title: First Point of Contact Administrator
description:
First Point of Contact Administrator

Location: Shrewsbury
Salary: £25,500 per annum increasing to £26,600 after probation
Job Type: Full Time
Training & Support: Full training provided

We are currently recruiting for a First Point of Contact Administrator to join a busy property management team based in Shrewsbury.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service, administration and communication skills who is looking to develop their career within the property sector. Full training and ongoing support will be provided.

The Role

As the first point of contact, you will play an important role in providing a professional and efficient service to clients, customers, contractors and leaseholders.

You will be responsible for handling incoming calls and emails, dealing with routine enquiries and ensuring more complex queries are directed to the appropriate Property Manager or department.

Key Responsibilities
- Answer incoming telephone calls and emails, providing a professional and helpful first point of contact.
- Handle routine client and customer enquiries and accurately triage more complex queries.
- Direct calls and correspondence to the appropriate Property Manager or internal department.
- Prepare and issue general correspondence to clients and leaseholders.
- Assist Property Managers and Department Heads with client, contractor and customer communications.
- Upload and maintain documentation across internal systems.
- Manage appointments and oversee the Shrewsbury office diary.
- Liaise with internal teams to obtain and provide information relating to property portfolios.
- Attend internal meetings where required.
- Ensure all work is carried out in line with relevant industry guidelines and best practice.
- Complete mandatory training and participate in additional training where appropriate.
- Maintain high standards of customer service and ensure customers are treated fairly.
- Keep up to date with relevant legislation and industry developments.
- Work collaboratively as part of a wider property management team.

About You

We are looking for someone who is:
- Customer-focused with a professional and friendly approach.
- Confident communicating by telephone, email and in person.
- Highly organised with good attention to detail.
- Comfortable managing multiple enquiries and prioritising workload.
- IT literate and confident using internal systems.
- A strong team player who is willing to learn and develop.
- Reliable, punctual and professional.
- Previous experience in administration, customer service, property or a similar environment would be beneficial, although not essential.

What's on Offer?
- £25,500 per annum increasing to £26,600 after probation
- Full training and ongoing support
- Opportunity to develop a career within the property management sector
- Supportive team environment
- Excellent opportunity for someone looking to establish themselves within residential property

If you're organised, personable and looking for an opportunity to build your career within property, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Our client is an established professional services business in Shrewsbury and they are looking for a Marketing Manager to deliver all marketing activities across the organisation. The role works closely with the Director responsible for marketing supporting the development of the overall marketing plan.

The Marketing Manager is responsible for managing the CRM system, co-ordinating internal communications and departmental marketing plans, organising events as well as maintaining social media and website content.

Duties
- Maintaining accurate and reliable client and prospect data
- Creating and managing marketing campaigns
- Supporting the development and implementation of marketing plans across departments
- Working with department heads to identify marketing opportunities and objectives for their clients
- Reviewing client survey feedback, sharing findings and co-ordinating follow up actions to support awareness and lead generation

Experience
- Experienced in a marketing or communications role
- Experienced in using Marketing Design Tools (eg Adobe Suite, Canva)
- Experienced in using CRM systems
- Experienced in managing social media platforms and website content
- Strong organisation and project co-ordination skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A marketing qualification or relevant professional certification (desirable)
- Experienced in using email marketing platforms (desirable)

title: Part-Time Telesales / Appointment Setter
description:
Part-Time Telesales / Appointment Setter

Location: Shrewsbury Office Based
Pay: £15.00 per hour + holiday pay
Hours: 10:00am 4:00pm, 3 to 5 days per week
Job Type: Part-Time, Permanent

An established Shrewsbury company that manufactures a large range of commercial vacuum cleaners and professional cleaning equipment is looking for an experienced Telesales / Appointment Setter to join their office on a part-time basis.

This is an office-based role it is not a home-working position.

You will make outbound sales calls to schools, hospitals, care homes, government buildings, factories, warehouses and commercial offices. Your role will be to speak to the appropriate person, introduce the company's products, generate interest and arrange appointments for a Sales Representative to visit and demonstrate the equipment.

Key Responsibilities
- Make outbound sales calls to potential customers.
- Identify and speak to the relevant decision-maker.
- Introduce the company's range of commercial vacuum cleaners and cleaning equipment.
- Generate interest and arrange appointments for the Sales Representative.
- Maintain accurate records of calls and appointments.
- Follow up previous enquiries where required.

Requirements
- Previous sales experience is essential.
- Confident and happy making outbound sales calls.
- Professional telephone manner.
- Comfortable speaking to managers and decision-makers.
- Persistent, organised and motivated.
- Good communication skills.

Hours & Pay
- £15.00 per hour + holiday pay
- 10:00am 4:00pm, 3 to 5 days per week
- Permanent, part-time position.
- Office based in Shrewsbury no home working.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced salesperson looking for regular part-time hours.

Apply today for more information.

title: Service Advisor
description:

OTE £35,000

title: Stock Control & Purchasing Coordinator
description:
Supply Chain Development within a Leading Equipment Supplier
Location - Shrewsbury
Salary: up to 40,000 pa + Benefits
Are you an experienced Stock Control or Purchasing professional looking for a varied role where you can take ownership of inventory management, purchasing and supplier relationships?
We are working with an established business looking to appoint a proactive and organised Stock Control & Purchasing Coordinator to support its operational requirements and ensure the efficient availability of materials, products and equipment.
The Role
You will play an important part in managing stock levels and coordinating purchasing activities, ensuring materials are available when needed while maintaining accurate records and controlling inventory costs.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Monitoring stock levels and raising purchase orders to meet operational requirements.
- Managing the purchasing process from obtaining supplier quotations through to order placement and delivery.
- Using SAP to maintain accurate inventory records, process purchase orders and manage goods receipts.
- Liaising with suppliers to track deliveries, resolve shortages and investigate stock discrepancies.
- Maintaining appropriate inventory levels while minimising excess, obsolete and slow-moving stock.
- Coordinating the supply of materials, equipment and consumables to support day-to-day operations.
- Monitoring supplier performance, pricing and lead times, identifying opportunities for improved efficiency and cost control.
- Producing stock, purchasing and supplier reports using SAP, Excel and other IT systems.
- Working closely with warehouse, finance and operational teams to ensure purchasing and stock control processes run smoothly.

About You

We're keen to speak with individuals who have previous experience in stock control, purchasing, procurement, materials management or supply chain coordination.
You'll ideally bring:
- Practical experience using SAP or a similar ERP system within a purchasing or inventory environment - essential.
- Strong Microsoft Office and Excel skills.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines.
- Good communication and supplier relationship management skills.
- A proactive, methodical and solutions-focused approach to resolving supply and stock issues.

Experience within a manufacturing, engineering, warehouse or wider operational environment would be particularly advantageous.
Interested?
This is an excellent opportunity to join an established operation in a varied position combining purchasing, stock management and supplier coordination. If this sounds like the right next step in your career, we would love to hear from you. Please apply with your full CV, quoting reference number 10576.

title: Technical Sales and Service Coordinator
description:
SF Partners are supporting an established Shrewsbury SW1 based business that are looking to recruit a Technical Sales and Service Coordinator on a permanent basis.

Salary: £35,000-£45,000
Working pattern: full time site based

We are seeking an experienced Technical Sales and Service Co-Ordinator to provide professional support to customers and internal departments throughout the sales and service process. The successful candidate will have previous experience in a similar role, the ability to interpret technical drawings, and a proven track record of providing technical advice, coordinating appointments, resolving customer issues, and arranging collections and deliveries. Proficiency in SAP is essential.
Key Responsibilities
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries, providing accurate technical and product information.
- Read, interpret and apply technical drawings, specifications and associated documentation.
- Advise customers on appropriate products, services and technical solutions in accordance with their requirements.
- Prepare, process and follow up quotations, orders and service-related documentation.
- Arrange and co-ordinate customer appointments, site visits, installations, inspections and service callouts.
- Arrange the collection and delivery of products, equipment and materials in liaison with customers, drivers, suppliers and relevant internal departments.
- Monitor orders and service requests, providing customers with timely updates regarding progress, delivery schedules and any changes.
- Investigate and resolve customer queries and service issues efficiently, escalating complex matters where appropriate.
- Maintain accurate customer, order, delivery and service records within SAP and other relevant business systems.
- Work collaboratively with the sales, service, warehouse, transport and technical teams to ensure the efficient operation of day-to-day activities.
- Provide support with stock management, returns, warranty claims and after-sales service processes as required.
- Ensure that all activities are conducted in accordance with company procedures, regulatory requirements and established customer service

Desirable Experience
- Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, construction, industrial or other technical environment.
- Experience coordinating deliveries, collections, installations or field-service activities.
- Familiarity with quotations, purchase orders, sales orders, returns and warranty processes.
- A relevant technical qualification or industry-specific training.
